subject: docs/coop/artifacts/platform-tcb-contract.v7.json

blockers.title: The filesystem profile member is derived from an undefined resolved volume after the complete profile must already be selected
evidence: resolutionPredicate orders 'Select the active complete platformProfile' before observing the actual object. But both per-osFamily token sources now read the filesystem type of 'the resolved volume'. The contract never designates which object or volume supplies the single filesystemWhereItAffectsResolution member before profile selection.

A TCB profile covers many loader, libc, framework, certificate, font, ICU, and helper resolutions that may occupy different or nested volumes. noOrJoin permits only one filesystem value and requires distinct filesystems to be distinct profiles, but no rule chooses one volume, requires all covered objects to share it, or moves the filesystem discriminator to each entry.

The Linux rule additionally names /proc/self/mountinfo without saying whether self is the tested resolver or the independent trusted observer, how the record for a nested/bind/over-mounted resolved path is selected, or what happens when selection is missing or ambiguous.
blockers.impact: Two conforming verifiers can compute different required filesystem members for the same qualification run, or cannot compute the complete profile before the resolution it gates. The frozen allowlist and G22 result therefore lack one reproducible profile key.
blockers.requiredRepair: Define a profile-level filesystem measurement target before profile selection and require all relevant resolutions to satisfy it, or make filesystem identity an entry/route-level value with a closed collection rule. For Linux, bind observation to the resolving process and mount namespace, specify the exact mount-record selection algorithm, and fail closed on missing or ambiguous selection.

shouldFix.title: sonameAbi is excluded from identity but its separate compatibility observation has no outcome
shouldFix.evidence: V7 consistently says presence, absence, or mismatch never decides identity and is not drift, then calls it a separate compatibility observation. No rule says whether that observation is informational, retained, compared, or causes a distinct compatibility refusal; resolutionPredicate and NT-TCB-1..4 contain no companion step or outcome.
shouldFix.impact: One verifier can log and allow a mismatch while another can refuse it as incompatible, despite both honoring the identity-exclusion language.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Choose and state one behavior. If sonameAbi is metadata only, say presence/absence/mismatch never changes allow/refuse and state how it is retained. If it gates compatibility, define exact comparison, a separate refusal outcome, trace evidence, and a negative-test property without reclassifying it as authenticity identity.

shouldFix.title: The standing rotation rule landed, but the frozen review's conditional-booking truth defect remains verbatim
shouldFix.evidence: idCollisionNote now states the predecessor-round/basedOn recovery rule, satisfying the main rotation repair. However notFoldedThisSuccessor still says 'CLAUDE-V5-ADV-2 residue, if any remains ... is booked.' Frozen CLAUDE-V6-S3 explicitly required replacing that conditional with an actual determination for each carried advisory, while honestyRepairsFromV6 claims S3 repaired.
shouldFix.impact: The repair ledger simultaneously claims completion and records that it has not determined whether the carried residue exists.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Make an unconditional determination: state that CLAUDE-V5-ADV-2 is resolved by the standing rule, or identify the exact remaining residue and disposition. Remove the 'if any' booking.

advisories.title: SONAME-ABI remains in the tags registry even though it is only a companion encoding pointer
advisories.detail: The entry is safely excluded from classMap, signed-entry fields, authenticity, and identity comparison, but a parser enumerating tags still sees a non-tag beside the two lawful union tags.
advisories.suggestedFix: Move the pointer to a sibling companions registry so tags contains exactly the forms classMap may select.

verdictBasis: REJECT: 1 blocker and 2 SHOULD-FIX findings. ACCEPT requires 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX.
conclusion: REJECT. The filesystem selector still lacks a pre-selection profile-level volume and deterministic Linux resolver/mount binding; sonameAbi compatibility has no defined outcome; and the ledger retains an unresolved conditional booking while claiming the frozen repair complete. DR-126 remains OPEN; no D-096 (A) grant, satisfaction, qualification, sealing, application, or implementation authority is created.
